headline: Indian IT services posted mixed revenue growth with a few high‑flying mid‑tier firms and modest top‑tier performance.
summary: Overall sector revenue grew around 10% YoY, driven by strong AI‑led deals at several companies. Mid‑size players such as Coforge and LTM posted double‑digit to high‑double‑digit growth, while the large peers Infosys and Wipro showed only modest top‑line expansion. Profit trends were mixed, with HCLTech and Mphasis delivering double‑digit profit jumps, whereas Infosys and Wipro saw slower profit growth. Guidance remained largely unchanged, though Infosys trimmed its FY27 outlook.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue acceleration
themes.detail: AI contributed to double‑digit revenue lifts at Infosys, LTM, Mphasis, HCLTech and TCS, underscoring its growing importance across the sector.

themes.title: Margin expansion at mid‑tier firms
themes.detail: Coforge raised its EBIT margin guidance to 16% and posted a 16% operating margin, reflecting improved cost efficiency.

themes.title: Profit pressure at large caps
themes.detail: Infosys profit rose only 6% YoY and Wipro profit fell 1.9%, indicating margin pressure despite revenue growth.
